# M3-0a: Carried sync and ynab cleanup

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-0a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-0a`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): sync/, ynab/
- Plan refs: STATE M2-0 and M1-1 follow-ups
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`finbot sync --archived` no longer skips a plan whose check failed this run but whose stored verdict is true, and a test
guards against ids entering `ynab` operation strings.

## Scope
- `sync/mirror.go` `ScanDiscretionary`: include a failed plan in the returned list when the persisted row keeps
  `has_discretionary` true. A failed plan with no prior good verdict stays out.
- `ynab/`: the op strings in `client.go` are already fixed constants. Add a test that drives each client error path with
  a known transaction id and plan id and asserts neither appears in the error.

## Out of scope
- New YNAB writes (M3-7). Scheduler or `cmd/` changes.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: a plan that fails the scan with a stored true verdict is returned and still reported in `ScanError.Failed`.
- [ ] Test: a plan that fails with no stored verdict is not returned.
- [ ] Test: no client error contains the transaction id or plan id.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
